heading: Rhea Ripley’s journey from Australia to becoming one of WWE’s biggest women’s stars, from the independent circuit to global championship glory and The Judgment Day
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 19:00 IST
paragraphs: The story of Rhea Ripley started, long before the title celebrations and WrestleMania appearances
Ripley was born Demi Bennett in Adelaide, South Australia and started her professional wrestling career as a teenager on the Australian independent circuit

Her early training with Riot City Wrestling laid the foundations for a career that would eventually see her go from local competition to the biggest stages of WWE.The Australian grappler slowly honed a unique physical style and dominating presence that distinguished her from many of her peers

Her time in international wrestling and WWE’s developmental system finally got her in front of a much bigger audience, while character changes helped set the tone for the persona that became so synonymous with her rise.Rhea Ripley built her WWE identity in AustraliaRhea Ripley started training with Riot City Wrestling in Australia at the age of 16
Wrestling under the name Demi Bennett, she quickly got experience on the independent circuit against established performers

Her progress included two reigns as the RCW Women’s Champion, giving her an early championship resume before WWE became part of her career path.Her Australian performances eventually led to opportunities outside Australia
Ripley also competed internationally, including appearances in Japan, and gained experience that broadened her wrestling style and exposure
Those gigs helped establish her as a promising young performer before WWE signed her.Ripley had a tryout with WWE in the past but wasn’t accepted then due to age requirements

She would later join WWE and make an important step in her transition from Australian prospect to international performer by competing in the 2017 Mae Young Classic.YearCareer milestoneSignificance2013Rhea Ripley begins training in AustraliaStarts professional wrestling journey2014–2017Riot City WrestlingWins the RCW Women’s Championship twice2017WWE Mae Young ClassicIntroduced to a global WWE audience2018NXT UKBecomes inaugural NXT UK Women’s Champion2019NXTDefeats Shayna Baszler for the NXT Women’s Championship2021WrestleMania 37Defeats Asuka for the Raw Women’s Championship2022The Judgment DayBecomes a prominent member of the faction2023–2025WWE main rosterEstablishes herself as a major women’s division headlinerIn her early days in WWE, she was much different from the darker image that became synonymous with her career

The character changed over time, becoming more aggressive in appearance with the use of leather, spikes and a gothic-inspired aesthetic, a better reflection of her wrestling style that had become more physical.Rhea Ripley found championship success across WWE brandsRipley played a key part in the WWE’s expansion to NXT UK
In 2018, she became the first-ever NXT UK Women’s Champion by beating Toni Storm

The achievement placed her amongst the first major female Australian champions in WWE history and established her as a prominent figure on the emerging brand.Her success at the championship continued after she moved to NXT in the United States

Ripley beat Shayna Baszler for the NXT Women’s Championship in 2019, ending Baszler’s long reign and helping cement Ripley’s standing as one of WWE’s top young women’s wrestlers.Ripley’s other defining moment came at WrestleMania 37 in 2021, when she defeated Asuka to win the Raw Women’s Championship

It was one of WWE’s biggest annual stages, and another major step forward for her in her progression from developmental wrestler to main-roster headliner.She continued to add to her championship resume when WWE unveiled the Women’s World Championship

Ripley soon became entrenched in major premium live events, title programs and high-profile rivalries, cementing her status as a central figure in the women’s division.Rhea Ripley became central to The Judgment DayThe Judgement Day was all about why Ripley is so over is because of her character development

Her intimidating “Mami” persona gave her presentation a unique identity, and her physical style and confident promos cemented her as one of WWE’s most recognisable performers.Her being paired with The Judgement Day added a whole other layer to that character

Ripley was heavily involved in the faction with several other top WWE talents, helping to make the group one of the most visible acts on the main roster.Ripley’s profile rose, and she became a staple of the big storylines and premium live events for the WWE

Her mix of championship success, character work and high-profile rivalries helped elevate her from an Australian prospect to a global WWE star.Her journey also represents the growth of WWE’s international talent pipeline
